runs.command: cargo test -p dbide-pg-spike -p dbide-bridge -p dbide-mysql -p dbide-workflows -p dbide-mcp -p dbide-cli -p dbide-data --tests -- --ignored --test-threads=1

scope: Integrated backend and pre-row-editor UI checkpoint. Ongoing main UI edits require rerun before final acceptance.
limitations: Default ignored tests were run separately against owned loopback fixtures; native Keychain is separate.
GUI/drop/physical IME/performance are separate evidence, not implied by cargo tests.
Concurrent source changes mean this is a checkpoint, not immutable release certification.
